lines.text: The raiders have our depot. Now they're hitting our freight checkpoint. Land on the rear unloading apron and reinforce the gate. More raiders are approaching along the freight and warehouse service roads. Wayline provides militia and one shuttle. Eliminate the bandit force, and bring as many people home as you can. Six thousand credits on success. Then we can deal with the depot.

lines.text: We've lost the checkpoint's original defenders. Finish this, Captain. Bring the rest of our people home.

lines.text: Their assault is broken. Recovered traffic logs identify the occupied Wayline depot. Land at the western staging apron and advance with our militia through the freight gate, loading yard, and dispatch warehouse. Expect gate guards and a reserve deeper inside. Eliminate the bandit force. We provide one shuttle; your company needs lift for two sorties. Nine thousand credits on success, and I'll vouch for your company with Independent brokers. Let's give our drivers their road back.
